Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Slayn & Korpil Facilities]]: a close-up of the body copy of a Trane advertisement for the XL 1200 air conditioner ("It's the one with the exclusive 10-year warranty."), with the lines "And, most important, it's made by Trane. And that means quality." highlighted and outlined. The advertisement prints light text on a dark background; the crop is shown inverted (dark on light), enlarged three times and sharpened. The earlier, plainer crop is [[:File:Joke reference - Trane XL 1200 ad, Air Conditioning Heating & Refrigeration News 1987 (and that means quality).jpg]].

Source: ''Air Conditioning, Heating & Refrigeration News'', 6 April 1987 (1987 Statistical Panorama issue), scan at the [https://archive.org/details/micro_IA40706924_0238 Internet Archive] (item micro_IA40706924_0238, leaf 39). The Wayback Machine does not keep copies of archive.org's own pages, so there is no separate Preserved copy (Bill's call, 27 October 2026).

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a small crop of one advertisement, shown only to identify the real advertising line that the card's lore resembles, beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market.
